fusions.name: Eddy Paw
fusions.desc: Paddles up an eddy that deals 4 water damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, each with a 50% chance to be [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Paddled Spray
fusions.desc: Splashes a jet of water that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. 20% of the damage it deals comes back as healing over the following 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Calm Paddle
fusions.desc: Restores 12 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles, and more the faster you cast. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Buoyed Up
fusions.desc: When you are healed, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
